title: Upcoming NFT Mint | COPICafe Episode 34 | Cornucopias
description:
Racing Game Updates! A HUGE Partnership! (more details next week) And the upcoming NFT Mints!

In this episode of COPICafe Josh and Rob discuss some of the details of the upcoming racing game, and how Cornucopias is bringing eSports to Cardano. Excitement is building for the new website and all the features it's going to include. A big partnership with Meld is announced. Ken Olling, CEO of Meld will join Josh and Rob on the next edition of COPICafe to discuss the details of the partnership. Rob walks through the upcoming NFT mints including the the Farmer Joe Bobble Head test mint, where we are testing integration of the $COPI token.  This test is followed by the vehicle light kit mint and the Cheeky Crypto racing suit mint. 

00:00 - Introduction
00:40 - Beverage Choices  https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=38
03:04 - Racing Game Update  https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=184

11:20 - Next Weeks Special Guest + Partnership Announcement  https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=680
13:23 - NFT Test Mint (Farmer Joe Bobble Head) https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=802
16:12 - NFT Mint (Vehicle Light Kit)  https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=972
17:50 - NFT Mint (Cheeky Crypto Racing Suit)  https://youtu.be/_cq-7xJlMX4?t=1071

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI
